dedupe_keys.name: wind farm project valuation under revenue driven farm control considering life time extension

description: Gräfe, Moritz and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The WINPACT application links wake-aware response, turbine-load surrogates, fatigue accumulation and economic valuation for Hollandse Kust Noord. A revenue-triggered shutdown scenario curtails production below a ten-minute revenue threshold. Alternative assumptions about non-normal operating loads affect lifetime extension, which is propagated to NPV and LCOE under different revenue schemes. Results concern a modelled operational policy and conditional load assumptions, not a proven implemented shutdown programme at the farm. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. WINPACT is based on linking wake-aware loads to the financial appraisal.
